title: OffersIndex
description: Frozen data contract (issue #120, tasks.md Task 2.1) for the GENERATED offers.json / offers.jsonl artifacts produced by app/scripts/load-offers.mjs. This governs the build OUTPUT only — schemas/offer.schema.json still governs the YAML source and does not change. The pipeline validates its own output against this schema and fails the build on mismatch.

generated_at.description: Build timestamp, UTC, second precision with a trailing Z.

count.description: Total number of entries in offers (active + expired).

active_count.description: Entries whose status is active at build time.

expired_count.description: Entries whose status is expired at build time.

offers.description: All validated offers, newest-added first, then newest-verified, ties by slug ascending. Expired entries are retained and flagged, never dropped.

always_free.description: Curated 'Always free' shelf (#612): offer slugs from config/always-free.yaml in the curator's order. Every slug names an offer in offers; the home page shows only the ones that are active and not verification: unverified.

deals.description: Deals (#809): time-limited DISCOUNTS on paid AI products, kept apart from the free offers. Never counted in count / active_count / expired_count, never in offers, offers.jsonl, search, the feed or offer pages. Only deals still running at build time are listed (a deal is hidden from the day after its expiry_date), soonest-ending first. Every entry carries kind: deal.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: One offer entry in the generated index. Mirrors the YAML source fields plus the slug and the build-time-computed status.

slug.description: File name of the source offers/<slug>.yaml without extension.

title.description: Human-readable offer name shown on cards.

provider.description: Company or product offering the credit.

amount.description: Free value in human terms, e.g. '$300 in credits'.

expiry_date.description: Date the offer stops being claimable, YYYY-MM-DD. Null means ongoing.

source_url.description: Official provider page describing the offer.

verified_date.description: Date the curator last verified the offer is live, YYYY-MM-DD.

added_date.description: Date the offer's YAML first entered git history, YYYY-MM-DD; feeds the default ranking's newness signal. Null when the build has no git history (shallow clone). Always emitted by the loader; optional so older payloads stay valid.

review_status.description: Curator testing state, separate from evidence verification and build-time expiry.

status.description: Build-time expiry verdict (ADR 0001): computed against the BUILD clock, never a client clock.

listing_type.description: Present only on community entries (#748): a promo code or giveaway a person shared, NOT verified by freetokens. Absent on regular offers.

Community.title: Community
Community.description: Community listing details (#748), re-nested from the flat offers/*.yaml keys. Facts are quoted from the post; keys the post did not state are absent.

subtype.description: promo_code = a code anyone can redeem; giveaway = codes handed out to people who enter.

promo_code.description: promo_code subtype: the code as the post gives it.

codes_available.description: giveaway subtype: how many codes the post gives away.

entries_close.description: giveaway subtype: the day entries close, YYYY-MM-DD (equals expiry_date).

timezone_note.description: The post's time zone quoted, or 'no time zone given'.

SharedBy.title: SharedBy
SharedBy.description: Who shared a community entry, and where.

handle.description: Bare account handle of the poster (no @).

name.description: Poster's display name, when the post shows one.

post_url.description: Link to the post (the entry's source_url).

Deal.title: Deal
Deal.description: One running deal in the generated index (#809): the deals/<slug>.yaml fields plus kind and slug. Mirrors schemas/deal.schema.json.

kind.description: Always 'deal': marks the entry as a paid discount, never a free offer.

slug.description: File name of the source deals/<slug>.yaml without extension.

title.description: Deal name as shown on cards, e.g. 'Example AI Pro — Black Friday'.

category.description: Deal scope: ai_subscription = AI chat assistant subscriptions; coding_agent = coding agents and AI IDEs; ai_tool_api = AI tools and APIs; agent_compute = sandboxes, cloud VMs and compute for agents. Anything else is out of scope and rejected.

discount.description: The discount exactly as the official page states it, e.g. '50% off the first year'.

regular_price.description: Optional: the regular price, only when the official page shows it.

deal_price.description: Optional: the discounted price, only when the official page shows it. Must contain a non-zero digit (a deal is never free).

promo_code.description: Optional: the code to enter at checkout.

occasion.description: The sale event the deal belongs to (config/occasions.yaml names the windows).

start_date.description: Optional: first day of the deal, YYYY-MM-DD. Not after expiry_date.

expiry_date.description: Last day of the deal, YYYY-MM-DD. Required and never null: a deal must end. Hidden at build time from the next day on.

expiry_note.description: Optional: set when the official page states no end date and the occasion window end was used instead; says so in plain words.

source_url.description: The vendor's own page showing the discount (and its end date when stated).

verified_date.description: Day the deal was last checked on source_url, YYYY-MM-DD. Never in the future.

description.description: Optional: one or two sentences of terms quoted or closely paraphrased from the official page (who qualifies, which plan).
